newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ATHLETIC BILBAO CLOSE GAP ON LEADERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ATHLETIC BILBAO CLOSE GAP ON LEADERS.

text.p: Athletic Bilbao continued their recovery after a poor start to the season with an impressive 4-2 win at Sporting Gijon on Sunday.
The win lifted the Basque side to sixth place in the Spanish first division.
Athletic's superior goal difference moves them ahead of champions Atletico Madrid, 2-1 winners over Espanyol on Saturday, and Racing Santander, who beat Oviedo 1-0.
All three teams have 21 points from 13 games, two behind Real Betis, who drew 2-2 at Zaragoza thanks to a late penalty, and Valladolid, who face leaders Barcelona on Monday.
Deportivo Coruna's goalless draw at Compostela on Saturday pushed Real Madrid back to a provisional third ahead of their game at Sevilla, which kicked off late on Sunday.
